It concerns the desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should check in with Aurelia Skyways staff before heading to security, so the trip starts smoothly and your animal gets the right support.

Please keep carriers closed until a staff member asks you to open them, and keep leashes short in busy areas. Bring the usual essentials for a calm journey, and let the desk know right away if your pet needs water, a quiet pause, or help moving through the terminal. Safety stays ahead of speed on every trip, and respectful updates help us keep things steady for everyone.

If you are connecting through Vellmar, <<FACT F002>> please follow the local signs and use the pet lounge as directed. If your route includes Thornwick, <<FACT F016>> and ask the desk for a quick reminder before you leave the gate area. We are here to help travelers, pets, and crew keep the day moving in a calm way.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for the latest guidance and a friendly check of your plans.
